description:
A webhook on a `ForgejoRepository` (same namespace) or a
`ForgejoOrganization` — exactly one of the two refs.

authorizationHeaderSecretRef.description: Value sent as the `Authorization` header (write-only as well).

branchFilter.description: Glob limiting push/branch events, e.g. `main` or `{main,release/*}`.

deletionPolicy.description: What happens to the Forgejo object when its CR is deleted.

organizationRef.description:
Reference to another CR of this operator, by `metadata.name`. Always a
CR, never a raw Forgejo name: a cluster-scoped target is looked up
cluster-wide, a namespaced one in the referencing CR's own namespace only.

repositoryRef.description:
Reference to another CR of this operator, by `metadata.name`. Always a
CR, never a raw Forgejo name: a cluster-scoped target is looked up
cluster-wide, a namespaced one in the referencing CR's own namespace only.

secretRef.description:
HMAC secret signing the payloads. Write-only in Forgejo: a change of
the Secret's value is detected through `status.appliedSecretHash`.

type.description:
`forgejo` (default), `gitea`, `gogs`, `slack`, `discord`,
`dingtalk`, `telegram`, `msteams`, `feishu`, `wechatwork` or
`packagist`. Changing it recreates the hook.
